control.name: CONTROL — an uncomputed metric serializes a fabricated 0 instead of null (the headline honesty invariant: a blank DORA number must never publish as a measured zero)
control.old: m.Value = nil // an uncomputed metric is null, never 0

mutations.name: aggregate double-counts a finding once per affected stream (findingsPerGroup's per-group semantics wrongly reused in a pooled ratio)
the result cap truncates to the OLDEST records instead of the most recent (a capped delivery metric would report stale intervals)
a capped aggregate no longer reports itself partial (an undercount published as a complete measurement — the unqualified-capped-number defect)
an empty window fabricates a 0% change-failure rate instead of could-not-check ("nothing completed" published as "nothing ever failed")
mutations.old:
return buildDoraJSONMetric(false, 0, "ratio", append(needs,
			"completed work in the stated window to form a denominator"), nil)

mutations.name: the emitter also writes deployment_frequency (a source collision: two emitters writing one frozen key)
mutations.new:
doraChangeFail: changeFailureRate(history, findings, since, until),
		doraDeployFreq: buildDoraJSONMetric(true, 1, "deploys/week", nil, nil),

mutations.name: the unlinked proxy declares itself measured (a proxy published as a canonical DORA number)
the window filter is dropped, so out-of-window records are counted (a metric that silently covers a different period than it states)
the numerator reverts to every currently-open finding, whatever its date (an all-time backlog over a windowed denominator: a ratio with no upper bound)
a resolved in-window finding is dropped from the numerator (fixing a defect would un-fail the change that caused it)
a finding dated on the since day is excluded (the window's start made exclusive)
a finding dated on the until day is counted (the window's end made inclusive)
an undated finding is counted as if it were in the window (an unplaceable record silently inflating the numerator)
